source_claim: East Press's official Matogrosso series page identifies the work as ノス＆ザクロ by ラリアット and explicitly introduces its characters ノス・ザ・ノスフェラトゥ (Noss) and ザクロ・ザ・ヴァンパイア (Zakuro) in the series character roster.
notes: The official publisher's series page explicitly links both named campaign characters to this titled work. No creator-wide relation is inferred for other Rariatto characters.
